_provenance.status: APP-AUTHORED example records — no service owns them (see lib/api-client/lot-lifecycle.ts)
brief: Captain checklist F-11 (2026-09-18): the four lot-record screens in the property area — Ownership, Transfers, Interments and Exhumations. Domain wording follows docs/04-modules/memorial-property-gis.md §15 (lot record: owner/co-owners/authorised family/interred persons/documents) §19 (transfers) and §20–21 (interment and exhumation).
note: WHAT THIS IS: the office's own recorded file for a lot's paperwork — transfer requests, interments, exhumations and the papers that back a lot — as the staff screens show it today. The frozen lot-events-v1 contract (KEB-D3-01) exposes `occupied` and `for_transfer` as STATUS-ONLY and says plainly that interment and transfer workflows do not exist, and the Lot resource carries no ownership projection; so NO service response is being recorded here. These are app-authored example records with provenance, the same pattern as lib/fixtures/family/workspace.json.

WHAT IT CROSS-REFERENCES (pinned by tests/fixture-contract/lot-lifecycle.test.ts): every lot_id / lot_number is a lib/fixtures/property/lots.json row and a transfer's `from` is that lot's recorded owner_name; every interment's case_id / case_number / deceased_name come from lib/fixtures/operations/cases.json; every document_number exists in lib/fixtures/documents/documents.json; an exhumation's `destination` is a written receiving place (an external cemetery — it is where the family asks the remains to go, and is not required to be one of this product's own parks); a requester named here is a recorded lib/fixtures/crm/customers.json customer.

NEVER INVENTED: no amount, currency or fee figure appears anywhere (a transfer fee is 'the office's schedule applies', never a number); no owner is asserted beyond the lot's recorded owner_name and the purchase application's buyer; no approval, permit or ownership update is presented as done that no record confirms — the one final record, a completed interment, is backed by a completed case and a verified burial permit, while no exhumation has completed because nothing in the recorded file confirms one.

DATES: every `on` / `asked_on` is the calendar day the office wrote on the paper (yyyy-mm-dd), printed in UTC exactly as recorded. They are demo dates; the screens print only what a record carries and never derive one.
